references.text: Describes the conclusion of the people's crossing over the Jordan, which is the immediate context for Joshua 4:1
Israel's crossing of the Red Sea under Moses is a parallel to the crossing of the Jordan under Joshua
The people went through the sea on dry ground, in the same way as they crossed the Jordan
The Lord spoke to Joshua after Moses' death, a pattern that is repeated here after the crossing
Joshua was appointed as Moses' successor and received direct guidance from the Lord
Moses gave Joshua the task of leading the people into the land, which is now completed
